name: Effective Range / Repetition-Free Recursive Teaching Dimension
details: For every finite binary class, $\mathrm{rfRTD}(\mathcal H)\le E(\mathcal H)$.
proof: Discard the coordinates that are constant on $\mathcal H$, so the domain has $E(\mathcal H)$ coordinates. The full cube on that domain has a repetition-free teaching plan of order its domain size: recursively teach the 1-fibre using the chosen coordinate and then the 0-fibre, so the coordinate sets are all distinct. Restricting this plan to $\mathcal H$ preserves the teaching property and repetition-freeness. Hence it is a repetition-free teaching plan for $\mathcal H$ of order at most $E(\mathcal H)$.
witness_verification: On the $n$-singleton family, every coordinate is effective, so $E=n$, while the singleton concepts can be removed using their distinct one-coordinate positive teaching samples, giving $\mathrm{rfRTD}=1$.
